events.title: Richard the Lionheart defeats Saladin at Arsuf
events.description: Marching down the coast, Richard's army withstood harassing attacks before a crusader charge broke Saladin's forces at Arsuf. The victory let the crusaders take Jaffa.

events.title: The future Elizabeth I is born at Greenwich
events.description: Anne Boleyn gave birth to a daughter, Elizabeth, a disappointment to Henry VIII, who wanted a son. As queen for 44 years she defeated the Armada and presided over a golden age of English culture.

events.title: The submarine Turtle makes the first submarine attack
events.description: Sergeant Ezra Lee steered David Bushnell's one-man submarine Turtle towards HMS Eagle in New York Harbor. He failed to attach the charge to the hull, but it was the first submarine attack in war.
events.html: Sergeant Ezra Lee steered David Bushnell's one-man submarine Turtle towards HMS Eagle in New York Harbor. He failed to attach the charge to the hull, but it was the first submarine attack in war.

events.title: Napoleon and Kutuzov fight the Battle of Borodino
events.description: Some 70,000 men fell at Borodino, the bloodiest single day of the Napoleonic Wars. The Russians withdrew, and a week later Napoleon entered an abandoned Moscow that was soon ablaze.

events.title: The Blitz begins with a massive raid on London
events.description: The Luftwaffe switched to bombing London, starting 57 consecutive nights of raids. The Blitz killed some 43,000 civilians by May 1941 but failed to break British morale.
